QuestInfo.name: Tell Do Gong I Said Hi
QuestInfo.0: Will #b#p2071006##k of #b#m222000000##k regain its lost memory?
QuestInfo.1: #p2071006# told me it now remembers everything that has to do with #b#m250000000##k and #b#p2091001##k, and felt saddened that it hadn't been able to repay #p2091001# for all the good things he did for it due to the injury, and wanted me to say HI to him for it.
QuestInfo.2: I managed to relay #p2071006#'s greetings to #p2091001#. #p2091001# seemed shocked by #p2071006#'s injuries, and wished it a speedy recovery by asking me to deliver #b#p2091002##k to it. Okay, I better go back to #b#p2091002##k, now.

0.0: Ah! Hey there! Aren't you the one that gave me #t2022116#? Thanks to you, I finally remember everything on #m250000000#. From learning chess by looking over #p2091001#'s shoulder... to watching #p2091000# diligently train... to seeing #p2091002# secretly eating the #t2022143# that #p2091001# gave away as presents... I REMEMBER THEM ALL! Thank you so very much!
0.1: I wasn't even able to repay #p2091001# for all the good things he did to me... and now my wings are injured so I can't even fly there. I really feel bad about it. If you can... well, if you ever get a chance to head over to #b#m250000000##k, then please tell #b#p2091001##k that Swallow's doing well and that once the wings are healed, I'll be heading over there to say Hi. Can you do that for me?

yes.0: Thank you so very much! I, #p2071006#, never forget the good deeds from other people! I will repay you one of these days, and you know it! Have a safe trip to #m250000000#.

no.0: Do you not plan on visiting #m250000000# ever again? Ahhh... I guess I'll have to wait until my wings get better.

1.0: Oh, you're the one that promised me to say Hello to #p2071006# for me. How was it? Did you get to meet #p2071006#? Did you hear anything about it? What? #p2071006# was in #m222000000#?

yes.0: So... it's injured, can't move, and... you have to go all the way to check up on it. You must be tired... I mean, it always forgot things even before the injury. I hope it's alright... I'll have to ask for #p2091002# to make a medicine for #p2071006#... I'll let him know that you're on your way, so you should go visit him, get the #bmedicine#k, and give it to #p2071006#.

npc.0: Have you not gone to #b#m250000000##k, yet? #b#p2091001##k might be very concerned right about now...
